parameters.description: The opportunity's numeric Grants.gov ID, such as 364136, as Search opportunities and the trigger give it, or a link to its page on grants.gov.
parameters.name: opportunity_id

agency_code.description: The posting agency's code, e.g. DOE-ARPAE.

application_packages.description: The application packages to apply with through Grants.gov.

assistance_listing.description: The Assistance Listing number it applies to.

competition_id.description: The competition's ID, when it has one.

archive_date.description: When Grants.gov will archive it, as YYYY-MM-DD.

number.description: The Assistance Listing number (formerly CFDA), e.g. 81.135.

award_ceiling.description: The most one award can be, in US dollars. Empty when not given.

award_floor.description: The least one award can be, in US dollars. Empty when not given.

category.description: The kind of funding, e.g. Discretionary, Mandatory or Continuation.

close_date.description: The application deadline. Empty for a forecast, as YYYY-MM-DD.

close_date_note.description: What the agency says about the deadline, such as a time of day.

contact_details.description: The agency's contact details as it wrote them, as plain text.

contact_name.description: Who to contact at the agency.

cost_sharing_required.description: Whether applicants must share the cost (cost sharing or matching).

department.description: The agency's department, e.g. Department of Energy.

department_code.description: The agency's department code, e.g. DOE.

description.description: The synopsis (or the forecast's description), as plain text.

documents.description: The files attached to the opportunity, such as the full announcement.

description.description: The agency's description of the file.

folder.description: The folder it is filed in, e.g. Full Announcement.

mime_type.description: The file's type, as Grants.gov gives it.

uploaded_at.description: When it was attached, as ISO 8601.

url.description: A link that downloads the file.

eligibility_details.description: The agency's own words on who may apply, as plain text.

eligible_applicants.description: Who may apply, as Grants.gov's applicant types.

name.description: The applicant type, e.g. Small businesses.

estimated_award_date.description: When a forecast's awards are expected. Empty otherwise, as YYYY-MM-DD.

estimated_close_date.description: When a forecast's applications are expected to be due. Empty otherwise, as YYYY-MM-DD.

estimated_post_date.description: When a forecast is expected to be posted. Empty otherwise, as YYYY-MM-DD.

estimated_project_start_date.description: When a forecast's projects are expected to start. Empty otherwise, as YYYY-MM-DD.

estimated_total_funding.description: The total the agency expects to award, in US dollars. Empty when not given.

expected_awards.description: How many awards the agency expects to make.

fiscal_year.description: A forecast's fiscal year. Empty otherwise.

funding_category_details.description: The agency's explanation of an Other category, as plain text.

code.description: The instrument's code: G, CA, PC or O.

name.description: The instrument, e.g. Grant or Cooperative Agreement.

id.description: Grants.gov's numeric ID for the opportunity, e.g. 364136. Get opportunity takes it.

last_updated.description: When the agency last changed it, as ISO 8601.

links.description: Web pages the agency links to instead of attaching a file.

more_info_label.description: What that link is, in the agency's words.

more_info_url.description: A link the agency gives for more about the opportunity.

number.description: The opportunity number the agency gave it, e.g. DE-FOA-0003630.

posted_date.description: When it was posted, or forecast for a forecast, as YYYY-MM-DD.

description: Find U.S. federal grant funding on Grants.gov. Search every agency's forecasted, open, closed and archived opportunities by keyword, agency, category and eligibility, get one in full with its funding, deadline and documents, count matches by filter, and start a workflow when a matching opportunity is posted. No account or API key required.

grants_gov_new_opportunity_trigger.description: Runs when a federal grant opportunity is posted on Grants.gov, or forecast. Optionally only for keywords, one agency, one funding category or one kind of applicant.
